sources: https://campgrounds.rvlife.com/api/reviews/park/9885 (RV Life park 9885 'Blue Ox Customers RV Park', 5 reviews 6/2024-10/2025)
Google Maps place 'Blue Ox', 1 Mill Rd, Pender (4.4 from 36 reviews, 402-385-3051)

values.note: Blue Ox customers stay free (a 2025 reviewer: 'up to a week for no cost'); others pay a fee the company does not post. 'Call a week or so ahead of time to reserve a site' (same reviewer).

booking.source: https://www.blueox.com/about-us/rv-park/ ('You may park in your reserved site or call 402-385-3051 to reserve a site. You are welcome to stay with us for a night, or longer'), read 2026-11-04

note: Small RV park beside the Blue Ox towing-products factory in Pender (Mill Rd / Industrial Rd), on a paved loop with concrete pads, plus a dry-camping area. Free for Blue Ox service customers; others pay a fee (not posted; an older listing said $15). Welcome center (weekdays, Memorial Day-Labor Day) and a 24-hour storm shelter; factory tours. Enter from Industrial Road past Mill Road. --Claude
summary: Company page confirms the park, phone reservations (402-385-3051) and that guests may stay 'for a night, or longer'. RV Life reviews (5, all $0 as Blue Ox customers) say non-customers are charged; no rate is posted anywhere, so fees stay empty. Presence met (own page + phone). Not a long-stay park. Not waterfront. Pin ~120 m off the loop, fine.
flags: PRIVATE GATE: presence passes (company web page + phone 402-385-3051, matches stored). Price: no posted rate for non-customers; the only price indicator is RV Life's $ tier (avg_rate 14; 5.0 stars from 45 ratings). The note's '$15/night' non-customer rate has no source I could read, so it was not written to fees.

PUBLIC ACCESS (weak spot): the company page addresses 'our customers and guests', and RV Life lists it as 'Blue Ox Customers RV Park'. A 7/2025 RV Life reviewer: 'Blue Ox customers can stay up to a week for no cost ... There is a charge for non BlueOx'. So non-customers can stay, but it is a customer park first; EKKO is not a Blue Ox customer unless it carries a Blue Ox tow bar.
LONG-STAY: passes. A week-for-free customer policy, short service-visit stays in every review; no seasonal or resident sites mentioned.
GOOGLE: the 4.4 / 36-review Google listing is the 'Blue Ox' company place (factory point 42.10306,-96.71731), not a separate RV-park listing.
PIN OK: stored 42.10474,-96.71952 is at the park's NW corner road junction, ~120 m from the centre of the pad loop (~42.1042,-96.7181). Refine if wanted.
Site count 14 (derived) plausible: NAIP shows ~13-14 angled concrete pads on the loop plus RVs in the open dry-camping field to the south-west.
